- Test image: underside of green soybean leaf with numerous tiny, discrete reddish-brown pustule-like spots scattered across the surface
- Soybean_rust reference: microscopic panel shows identical pattern — small, scattered tan-to-brown pustules (uredinia) on the underside of the leaf
- Septoria_brown_spot: angular spots with leaf yellowing/defoliation — doesn't match (leaf still green, spots are round not angular)
- Frogeye: large circular lesions with shot holes — doesn't match

The small, scattered pustules on the underside of a green leaf is the classic presentation of soybean rust.
